definitionYaml:
version: "1.0"
name: "single_model_evidence_gate"
description: "Profile B: evidence pack + deterministic contract gate"
inputs:
  optional:
    - evidence_pack
outputs:
  decision:
    type: object
states:
  - id: PROPOSE
    initial: true
  - id: CLOSED
    terminal: true
transitions:
  - from: PROPOSE
    to: CLOSED
    trigger: propose_done
    guards:
      - g_propose
steps:
  - id: propose
    state: PROPOSE
    handler: primary_b
    config:
      agent_kind: vllm
      provider.model: "qwen3-coder-30b"
      provider.max_tokens: 1536
      provider.timeout_secs: 300
      see_prior: false
      num_agents: 1
      output_contract:
        contract_id: evidence-bound-decision
        format: json_object
        required_fields: [claims, decision]
        allowed_values:
          decision: [accept, reject, request_changes, request_more_evidence]
        evidence:
          claims_field: claims
          refs_field: evidence_refs
          allowed_refs_from_context: evidence_pack
      prompt: "You are the primary engineer reviewing a technical decision for the Underpass Choreographer platform. QUESTION: Should AWS G6 ephemeral workers be allowed to execute stateful model jobs (jobs whose correctness depends on state kept on the worker between invocations)? Decide: accept (allow stateful), reject (stateless only), request_changes or request_more_evidence.\nEVIDENCE PACK (the ONLY citable evidence; cite by id in evidence_refs):\n- [ev-t3-ip-changes] Every stop/start of the G6 changes its public IP; the control plane must resync the WireGuard endpoint (wg-sync). Verified across multiple starts on 2026-07-03/04 (endpoints 18.101.186.131, 15.216.147.179, 15.217.12.130).\n- [ev-t3-idle-reaper] A reaper stops the G6 after 300s without vLLM requests (Prometheus vllm:num_requests_running == 0 sustained); shutdown can happen at any moment between jobs and is logged with timestamps. The shutdown policy is part of the platform design, not an accident.\n- [ev-t3-ebs-persists] The G6's EBS volume (100GB: model weights, container images) persists across stop/start — disk state survives, but process/GPU memory state does not.\n- [ev-t3-capacity-scarce] g6 capacity in eu-south-2a is scarce: starts fail with capacity errors and need retries (observed repeatedly; first start attempt failed on 3 of 4 session starts on 2026-07-03/04). A worker may not come back promptly after a stop.\n- [ev-t3-registry-inmemory] The choreographer's agent/council registry is in-memory per pod: engine-side state also does not survive restarts. The platform's persistence model is: evidence persists (S3/Tempo/Loki/Prometheus), compute state does not.\nEvery claim MUST cite at least one evidence id from the pack in its evidence_refs; claims you cannot support, leave out. CRITICAL OUTPUT FORMAT: your ENTIRE response must be raw JSON — the first character of your response must be { and the last must be }. NEVER wrap it in ``` fences. Shape: {\"claims\": [{\"text\": \"...\", \"evidence_refs\": [\"ev-...\"]}], \"decision\": \"accept|reject|request_changes|request_more_evidence\", \"risks\": [\"...\"], \"assumptions\": [\"...\"]}"
guards:
  g_propose:
    type: automated
    check: "step_status:propose:COMPLETED"
roles:
  - id: PRIMARY_ENGINEER
    allowed_actions:
      - propose
      - propose_done
timeouts:
  step_default: 600
retry_policies:
  default:
    max_attempts: 2
    backoff_seconds: 2
